# Copilot instructions — Papeto

Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root (and `be/AGENTS.md` or `frontend/AGENTS.md` for those folders).
Game rules: `docs/domain/pet-rules.md`. Product and privacy rules: `docs/product-rules.md`.

Hard rules: no calories, macros, weight or meal scores anywhere; never store meal photos; 18+ only;
meal endpoints require the `meal_data` consent; code and identifiers in English, UI text only in i18n (pt-BR);
no provider SDK imports outside `be/app/providers`.
